worked_solution:
The word "and" is represented by the symbol "$\land$".

So, the sentence reads

\[
\underbrace{6 \vphantom{p}\textrm{ is a composite number} }_R \quad \underbrace{\vphantom{p}\textbf{and}}_{\land} \quad 
\underbrace{2 \vphantom{p}\textrm{ is negative} }_S,
\]

that is, $R \land S.$
